proof.title: A fake screenshot cannot pass.
proof.lede: Chatfront reads the screenshot, then looks for the credit SMS on the shop's own phone. An order is marked paid only when the amount, the transaction ID and the time all agree.
proof.verdict: All three match: the order is marked paid and a signed receipt goes out. If anything differs, the owner gets Approve and Reject buttons with the evidence.

owner.help: I'm your shop's assistant. To add a product, send its photo, then its name and price in a voice note or in writing. To change a price or a shop policy, just tell me, for example: "lawn 3-piece is now 2,500". To record an expense, send a bill photo with the word "bill". Tell me udhaar like "Bilal ko 3000 udhaar", or ask "aaj ki sale?". Tell me stock that came in ("blue lawn ke 30 aa gaye") or send the supplier's bill with the word "challan", and send "products" or "orders" to see them.

console.coupon_max: Most times it can be used
console.coupon_show: Show it on the shop page as a sale, with a countdown
console.loyalty_share: Most of an order points can pay (%)
console.loyalty_note: Customers get a point for every {earn} on delivered orders, and each point takes {value} off, up to {share}% of an order.
console.events_lede: Days your customers want things before, such as a mela or the wedding season. The shop page and the assistant tell them the last day to order.
console.waitlist_lede: Customers who asked to be told when something is back. They hear in their chat when stock comes in. A WhatsApp chat quiet for more than 24 hours cannot be written to, so contact those customers yourself.
console.waitlist_status.missed: Back in stock, could not be told
console.answers_lede: Answers you gave in a chat and then approved. The assistant gives them to anyone who asks the same; remove one and it stops at once.
imports.title: Bring in your products
imports.lede: From a sheet, your Meta catalog, your Instagram posts or a video of your rack. What is found waits here; nothing goes on sale until you add it.
imports.video: Upload a video of your rack
imports.hint: A sheet needs a name column and a price column. Keep a video short, as you would on WhatsApp, and say the prices in it or type them here.
imports.sheet_read: Sheet read. Check the drafts below.
imports.started: Reading now. The drafts appear here in a few minutes.
imports.found: {count, plural, one {Found # product} other {Found # products}}; {waiting} still waiting
imports.add_ready: Add the ones with your prices
imports.added: {count, plural, one {Added # product to your shop.} other {Added # products to your shop.}}
imports.name: Name
imports.price_image: Price read from the picture: check it before adding.
imports.price_said: Price heard in the video: check it before adding.
imports.price_tag: Price read from a tag in the video: check it before adding.
imports.in_shop: Looks like {name}, already in your shop.
imports.error: That did not work. Try again.
imports.error_columns: The sheet needs a name column and a price column.
imports.error_model: Reading this needs the AI model, which is not on yet.
imports.error_running: An import of this kind is still reading. Try again in a few minutes.
imports.error_incomplete: A product needs a name and a price.
imports.busy: Another video is still being read. Send this one again in a few minutes.
imports.video_reading: Got your video. I am finding the products in it; in a few minutes they will wait as drafts in your console, where you check the prices and add them: {link}
shop.size_chart_help: Body measurements in {unit}. Not sure of your size? Ask in the chat.
sizes.title: Size charts
sizes.lede: Each size's body measurements, for the products in the categories you choose. The shop page shows the chart with those products, and the assistant uses it to tell customers their size.
sizes.name: Chart name
sizes.categories: For these categories (none ticked: every product with sizes)
sizes.failed: Not saved. Write each range from smallest to largest with a dash between, give the chart a name, and list each size once.
stock.count_lede: Take a photo of a shelf or rack. The count is set beside your books; change any number, then set the stock.
stock.count_saved: {count, plural, one {Stock set for # product.} other {Stock set for # products.}}
stock.count_whole: Each count must be a whole number.
stock.count_nothing: Nothing in the photo matched your products. Try a closer photo.
stock.count_error: The count was not saved. Try again.
stock.count_error_model: This photo could not be counted now. Try a clearer photo later, or send it in your chat with the words "stock count".
stock.count_short: {name}: {before} in the books, {counted} on the shelf ({missing} missing)
stock.count_extra: {name}: {before} in the books, {counted} on the shelf ({extra} more)
stock.count_loss_note: Missing pieces come off your oldest stock, and what they cost goes in the books as a loss.
stock.count_unread: I could not count this photo. Send a clearer photo of the shelf with the words "stock count", or count in the console.
stock.need_count: I could not count {item}. How many are there?
